profile.headline: Software Engineer at Catalist
profile.summary: Broadly experienced, adaptive engineer with a passion for high-performance distributed web systems, machine learning, data modeling & analysis, process engineering, technical leadership, network applications, and intuitive user interfaces.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Helping Verve model and exchange audiences at scale to innovate in the location-based mobile ad industry. Processing billions efficiently with Spark, Hadoop, Pig orchestrated in dynamic clusters.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web security and scalability consulting and development for the College Board with Scala, Java, and Javascript in AWS

Independent consulting on web systems, data, and machine learning primarily with Java and Scala

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, built, maintained an event collection web platform in Java interfacing to over 14 million sites, serving billions of requests a day

Designed and built a distributed marketing audience modeling system in Scala/Akka

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Designed applications and services for managed DNS suite leveraging the world's largest DNS infrastructure

Won company-wide engineering contest classifying websites using machine learning

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Estimation, design, development, and security of enhancements to a financial reporting web-application

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: Technical lead on centralized access control system for USPS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Constructed many components, including security framework, of a USDA web-application

Designed database entities, relationships, and constraints in line with class relationships and O/R mappings

Designed executive-dashboard module including pluggable and extensible charting and reporting mechanism

positions.title: Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Short research project to determine feasibility of Arabic handwriting recognition system

Designed raster to vector image conversion utility for extracting linear features without user intervention

positions.title: Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Developed mechanism to translate between first-order logic representations of games from Stanford’s General Game Player (GGP) and an object-oriented model for the NRL’s Testbed for Integrating and Evaluating Learning Techniques (TIELT) implemented in Java with HTTP

Developed naval amphibious plan editor
